summary: The diff implements a new 3D globe component with local Earth textures, renders clickable member pins from coordinates, and adds a WebGL capability check with a fallback message. Some REQ-1 acceptance criteria (rotate/zoom interaction and preserving existing page behaviors like directory click scroll-to-top) cannot be confirmed from the provided truncated diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Keep the existing Community Map page framework intact (route /community-map, header, member directory cards, stats panel) and preserve directory-card click behavior (select on globe + scroll-to-top).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary only shows changes to `CommunityMapPanel.tsx` and the new globe-related files; it does not show the surrounding page/route component behavior or the member directory click/scroll-to-top behavior, so this cannot be verified from the diff summary.

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in any requirement or acceptance criteria; REQ-1 specifies user-driven rotate/zoom interactions, not auto-rotation.
Not requested; only lat/lon positioning on a sphere is required for pins.
